method: built-in image_gen; new original three-view head artwork, no eye transplant

prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: ONE transparent RimWorld pawn HEAD sprite, SOUTH / straight-on FRONT view, to replace a rejected Sonetto head.
Reference image 1 is Sonetto's original character artwork: use ONLY for identity, hairstyle, colors and restrained attentive expression. Reference image 2 is the local pawn style board: use ONLY for flat small-game-sprite drawing, compact face proportions, bold dark silhouettes and simplified facial marks. Do not copy another character's identity or the labels/checkerboard.
Redraw Sonetto (Reverse:1999) as a single isolated upright head. True straight-on symmetrical camera, no tilted or three-quarter head. Warm copper/auburn orange hair, black and ivory diamond/check patterned headband over the crown. Character-specific swept curled fringe with a single broad rolled forelock across the forehead. Long loose wavy hair flows BEHIND the head, several broad tapering locks, a natural slightly asymmetric silhouette; not two separate identical thick ringlet pigtails. Two small understated upper swept-back hair gathers may remain, not animal ears or decorative buns. One short plait along HER LEFT temple (viewer RIGHT), ending in a small dull gold clasp near the jaw. Keep the plait distinct from the loose long hair. Other side has the original loose cheek-framing lock. Small check ribbon behind the gather if visible; no invented accessories.
Face: compact mature teen/young woman pawn face similar to the small game references. Softly tapered short jaw, short rounded chin, not a disc, not a long point. Small simple grey-green eyes with distinct pupils and a single tiny highlight each; natural spaced facial layout. A small readable nose mark and a very small lightly parted neutral mouth. Attentive, composed, mildly questioning expression from the artwork, relaxed slender eyebrows, no angry frown, no smile or chibi surprise. No freckles, scars or blush.
Style: flat simplified 2D sprite, near-black BOLD outer contour corresponding to about 3-4 pixels at a final 256px pawn texture; much weaker sparse internal hair lines. Only two or three broad matte tones per material. No detailed portrait rendering, no glossy streaks, gradients, soft lighting, long eyelashes, or individual hair filaments. Keep identity details in large readable shapes; slight pixel-game softness is fine, not polished vector-like hair geometry.
Composition: one head with all the long hair, fills roughly 80% height of a square image, centered with clear transparent margins. Head, ears, hair and headband ONLY. Absolutely no neck stump, shoulders, clothing, torso, hands, floating accessories, text, border, background, checkerboard or cast shadow. Real transparent alpha.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the newly generated Sonetto SOUTH/front pawn head in image 1. Image 2 is the original identity reference.
Keep the new head's upright frontal face, compact jaw, attentive slightly parted neutral mouth, short braid on viewer RIGHT, long loose wavy hair, flat palette and heavy simplified sprite outlines.
Correct only the crown construction: the two tall paired peaks currently look like animal ears. Sonetto is human. Lower those peaks drastically into small swept-back gathers sitting close to a gently rounded human skull, like the actual original illustration. Do not replace them with buns or two raised loops. Remove the two large checker-pattern triangles/bows sticking out beside the crown; those are invented. Narrow the central black-and-ivory headband to a slim curved strip about half its current thickness with two small readable rows of checks, seated naturally behind the rolled fringe. Keep one modest narrow check ribbon trailing behind the existing gather only where structurally appropriate, not large decorative bows. The large rolled forelock should remain a single coherent curved front lock.
Preserve the rest of the face and hair design. No new jewelry or expression change. Continue the same flat simplified RimWorld pawn sprite style with sparse internal detail. Real transparent background, head and hair only, no neck, shoulders, text, frame or shadow. Leave clear transparent margin around every hair tip.

Use case: style-transfer / consistent character turnaround. Create ONE transparent EAST head sprite of Sonetto for RimWorld, a TRUE 90-degree side profile facing RIGHT.
Image 1 is the new front head: it is the definitive matching design for this turnaround, colors, simplified shapes and ink weight. Image 2 is the original Sonetto artwork for identity and hair structure. Image 3 shows existing native right-profile pawn heads as proportion and rendering references only. Do not copy their identities or the board.
Draw the same human Sonetto head rotated to true right-facing profile, showing only the near eye and near side of her face. Upright skull and face, no downward or forward tilt, no three-quarter view. Compact but adequately broad exposed cheek/face and short softly tapered jaw; a small natural nose tip, small readable nose/lip distinction and short rounded chin. Do NOT compress the face into a thin vertical sliver; the face, hair and headwear must be separately proportioned. Same attentive, mildly questioning, calm expression with tiny slightly parted neutral lips, not a smile or angry frown. Simple grey-green visible eye and slender soft eyebrow. No freckles.
Copper-auburn orange long loose wavy hair, compact rounded crown with understated small swept-back gathers, no tall animal-ear peaks or buns. Thin black-and-ivory checked headband curves over the skull behind the swept rolled forelock. One short temple braid on HER LEFT side is the visible near-side braid: it runs down in front of the ear, ends near the jaw in the same small dull-gold clasp as the front. Keep it behind the exposed face outline, not over the eye. A modest narrow check ribbon trails behind the near-side gather. Long hair descends mainly behind the head towards the left, several broad overlapping tapered locks matching the front's length, not two enormous identical corkscrews and not a giant fan blown by wind.
Flat small-game-sprite drawing, bold near-black outer contour, sparse weak inner lines, two or three broad matte hair tones; no realistic gradients, glossy highlights, fine individual hair strands or elaborate eye details. Match the front head's palette and line weight closely.
ONE isolated head plus ALL hair, ear and hair accessories on actual transparent alpha, all tips inside clear margins. Head fills roughly 80 percent of a square canvas. No neck stump, shoulder, collar, torso, other objects, text, border, checkerboard or shadow.

Use case: consistent character turnaround / style-transfer. Create ONE transparent NORTH / straight BACK view head sprite of Sonetto for RimWorld.
Images 1 and 2 are the new matching front and right-profile heads. Use their SAME identity, copper-auburn hair palette, simplified broad locks, heavy ink weight, hairstyle length and thin check headband. Image 3 is original artwork for identity. Image 4 is the native pawn rear-head style board for drawing conventions only.
True direct rear orthographic view of an upright human head, not a three-quarter view; NO FACE, eyes, nose or mouth. Compact rounded human cranium with understated swept-back small side gathers integrated into the hair close to the skull, no ears or horns on top, no large buns. Long loose wavy copper-orange hair descends from the back of the skull as one coherent broad flowing mass divided into only a few large tapering locks, natural asymmetry in the ends. Match the length of the new front/profile hair. Do not draw two isolated identical curled pigtails, many ringlets, realistic hair threads, or extra long braids.
The thin black-and-ivory check band is on the top/front of the skull: from behind only a restrained edge at the upper crown can show, partly occluded by hair. One modest narrow check ribbon hangs behind HER LEFT upper gather, on viewer LEFT in this back view; keep its side consistent with the front viewer RIGHT and the near side in right-profile. The short temple braid and gold clasp are on her LEFT temple in front of her left ear, largely occluded from the rear. If a tiny glimpse appears at the left outer edge it must be subordinate; never copy a front braid into the center or both sides of the back.
Same flat simplified small-game-sprite style: bold near-black outer contour, sparse subdued interior hair strokes, two or three matte hair tones, no glossy streaks, detailed gradients, hairline texture, lighting effects or ornamental additions. Keep rear skull scale consistent with the new front/profile rather than inflating the whole silhouette to show details.
One isolated head plus all hair and hair accessories on real transparent alpha, clear margins around hair tips, fills roughly 80% of square canvas. No neck stump, clothing, shoulders, torso, body, detached decorations, text, checkerboard, border, background or shadow.
